learning_goal.ja: R²には異なる見た目の基底が複数あり得ることを理解する。
learning_goal.en: Understand that R2 can have multiple bases with different directions.

learner_question.ja: 標準基底でない斜めの二本も、なぜ平面の基底になれるのか。
learner_question.en: Why can two slanted vectors form a basis even when they are not standard axes?

visual_encoding: Two panels use the same plane and a shared target point; arrows show two different pairs of independent directions, while the caption states that both pairs span R².
misconception_risk: The slanted pair must be orthogonal.
Only the standard basis can be a basis.

alt_text.ja: 同じR²の平面に、標準基底の水平・垂直の二本と、斜めに開いた非標準基底の二本を左右で比較し、どちらも平面をspanし独立であると示す図。
alt_text.en: Two panels compare horizontal-vertical standard basis vectors with slanted independent non-standard basis vectors; both span R2.
